req.title: Delete player
req.statement: The system shall delete the specified player and respond with HTTP 204 when DELETE /players/{playerId} is called.

doc.reasoning: The DELETE /players/squadnumber/{squad_number} endpoint must return HTTP 204 on success, HTTP 404 when the player does not exist, and the player must be verifiably absent after deletion. Tests cover: (1) EP positive — delete an existing player and confirm 204 + subsequent 404 on re-fetch; (2) NEG — delete a non-existent squad number returns 404; (3) BVA — delete the lowest squad number in the fixture (1) and the highest (26) to catch off-by-one mutations on boundary IDs; (4) STC positive — delete then re-delete the same player to confirm idempotency is NOT assumed (second call returns 404, not 204); this is a state-transition scenario that starts with a valid positive action before verifying the resulting negative state, so kind=positive is correct for STC; (5) NEG — delete with a non-integer squad number path segment returns 422 (FastAPI path validation). The violation in test[4] was that kind=negative was paired with heuristic=STC; STC tests exercise state transitions and are inherently positive-flow tests — the fix is to set kind=positive on that test. Each test asserts exact status codes to kill constant-mutation and comparison-flip mutants.

tests.name: test_delete_existing_player_returns_204
preconditions: Player with squad_number=10 (Messi) exists in the database
expected: DELETE returns HTTP 204 with no body
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

r = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/10')
assert r.status_code == 204, f'Expected 204, got {r.status_code}'
assert r.content == b'', f'Expected empty body, got {r.content}'
r2 = client.get('/players/squadnumber/10')
assert r2.status_code == 404, f'Expected 404 after deletion, got {r2.status_code}'

tests.name: test_delete_player_get_all_no_longer_contains_deleted
preconditions: Player with squad_number=11 exists in the database
GET /players returns a list of all players
actions: Assert squad_number=11 is not present in the returned list
expected: GET /players list does not contain a player with squad_number=11
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

r_del = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/11')
assert r_del.status_code == 204, f'Expected 204, got {r_del.status_code}'
r_all = client.get('/players')
assert r_all.status_code == 200, f'Expected 200 from GET /players, got {r_all.status_code}'
players = r_all.json()
squad_numbers = [p.get('squad_number') for p in players]
assert 11 not in squad_numbers, f'squad_number=11 still present in player list after deletion'
